changes: Relaxed torsion-drive energies were converted from hartree to kcal/mol relative to each scan's own minimum, and each scan was classified by the rotatable-bond type used by this tool. No energies were recomputed.
server_licence_note: The public QCArchive server itself states no site-wide data licence; only OpenFF-submitted datasets are used by default.
